# FireAndForget

> Kotlin Multiplatform library to run code once (or N times) with pluggable persistence: onboarding, announcements, tutorials. Targets Android, iOS, Desktop (JVM), JS and WasmJS. Maven group: `com.github.alorma.fire-and-forget`.

## Using the library

- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alorma/FireAndForget/main/docs/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md): dependencies, API, runners, examples, common mistakes. Start here.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alorma/FireAndForget/main/README.md): longer examples.

## Working on the library itself

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alorma/FireAndForget/main/AGENTS.md): architecture, build commands, conventions.

## Optional

- [Sample code](https://github.com/alorma/FireAndForget/tree/main/samples/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/alorma/fireandforget/shared): compilable usage, including an in-memory runner.
